claim: Works offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:offline-shell' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: Fresh 390px browser context visits the bundled demo, waits for its service worker, goes offline, then reloads the demo.

test: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:no-web-tracking' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: Fresh 390px browser context records every request and cookie while loading the bundled demo; only same-origin requests and no cookies are accepted.

claim: The CLI keeps PDFs local, records external addresses without requesting them, and does not modify the input PDF.
test: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:local-only-cli' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: The CLI demo fixture is rewritten to point at a local HTTP probe. The test requires zero probe requests, a recorded external-link result, and an unchanged input hash.

claim: The free CLI runs without an account, checks bundled PDF links, writes an HTML map and JSON, and uses exits 0, 1, and 2 for success, policy failure, and invalid input.
where: landing capability/install copy and README usage, validation, and exit-code sections
test: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:cli-audit-and-ci' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: The CLI demo runs with an empty environment, its JSON and HTML map are inspected for valid, broken, external, and manifest results, then broken-policy and malformed-input exits are asserted.
